**Title: “Wings on the Wind”**

*(Verse 1)*  
Morning breaks on a silver sky,  
A choir of feathers, a lullaby.  
They paint the horizon with a sigh,  
Little hearts that dare to fly.  

*(Pre‑Chorus)*  
From the tallest oak to the river bend,  
They whisper stories that never end.  
Every wingbeat, a promise, a trend,  
In the hush of dawn, they’re the world’s best friend.  

*(Chorus)*  
Oh, sing with the sparrows, dance with the dove,  
Let the wind carry your dreams above.  
In the hush of the forest, in the city’s glow,  
Birds remind us how to let our spirits grow.  

*(Verse 2)*  
A robin’s red chest, a hawk’s keen eye,  
They glide through clouds where secrets lie.  
Their songs are maps to the open sky,  
A compass for the heart that’s shy.  

*(Pre‑Chorus)*  
When the storm rolls in, they’re the calm,  
A living hymn that breaks the dam.  
They teach us how to rise, to stand, to slam,  
The world’s a stage, and we’re the jam.  

*(Chorus)*  
Oh, sing with the sparrows, dance with the dove,  
Let the wind carry your dreams above.  
In the hush of the forest, in the city’s glow,  
Birds remind us how to let our spirits grow.  

*(Bridge)*  
When the night falls, they’re the lanterns bright,  
Guiding lost souls through the velvet night.  
Their wings are stories, their feathers light,  
A promise that hope takes flight.  

*(Breakdown)*  
(Soft, melodic)  
“Fly, little one, beyond the trees,  
Beyond the doubts, beyond the seas.”  

*(Final Chorus)*  
So let’s sing with the sparrows, dance with the dove,  
Let the wind carry our dreams above.  
In the hush of the forest, in the city’s glow,  
Birds remind us how to let our spirits grow.  

*(Outro)*  
When the day ends, the sky turns gold,  
And the birds, they whisper, “Be bold.”  
We’ll keep their song in our hearts, untold,  
Until the next sunrise, when the story unfolds.
